title: Chatbot model
experimentOff: No candidate is in the test. Every session uses the active version.
experimentOn: A candidate is in the A/B test. The other sessions stay on the active version.
rejected: Validation did not authorize the promotion. The candidate was kept.
empty: There were no examples to train on.
busy: A training run is already in progress.
emptyPeriod: There are no queries in the period.
